plan.treatment: Probability forced to 1 vs 0, with candidate growth and all other settings retained. Conditional effect of selected continuation; not removal of all growth.
plan.duration: Only ticks changes between lengths. Opening prices, stage positions and terminal durations scale through existing rules; per-tick events/fees and bot lookbacks stay unchanged. Longer worlds are not identical paths stretched in time.
plan.review: No new bot or engine code. Existing reviewed v15 roster and release binary. Confirmed bots do not read Rules.dragon; labels and seed reconstruction only in offline analysis.
plan.metrics: Price peaks / actual opening reference price; dividend peaks; fixed-current-dividend remaining-cashflow yardstick; on/off market-wide liquidity, volume, returns and liquidation. All worlds retained; no tuning.
plan.primary: Compare median selected-stock price peak multiples and >=5x/>=10x counts across lengths; compare paired on-off effects for each length separately.

previous_cohort.source: osprey-v2-holdout early_old, 72001..72020, 11 selected worlds; one extra ordinary research account

interpretation: A selected-growth treatment is compared with candidate-only growth at each length. All non-selected dividend paths and all initial account endowments agree within each on/off pair. Across lengths, the simulation is not a pure stretch: per-tick shocks/fees and fixed-tick strategy windows persist.
